response.rationale: Many T3-T4 sources (Hu & Nation 2000, Laufer 1989 and 2010, Schmitt et al. 2011, Nation 2006, Webb & Rodgers 2009) agree that comprehension rises with known-word coverage, with about 95% giving minimal and 98% giving optimal comprehension, and the only negative item (talk:19's counterpart, talk:3, a T6 claim that half is enough) is a low-tier claim that the same cited studies contradict, so it doesn't weaken the hypothesis.
